description: Responder-entered incident mechanisms and warning signs for prioritizing human review. This is not a diagnostic or video-analysis dataset.

sources.name: American Red Cross: First Aid Steps
sources.scope: General scene-check and emergency escalation reference; consult current local protocols and training.

causes.label: Falls or height-related hazards
causes.note: Look for head, limb, or spinal concerns after a drop, collapse, or elevated fall.

causes.label: Roadway or transport collisions
causes.note: Repeated impact and restraint patterns may produce head, chest, or limb injury concerns.

causes.label: Fire, heat, or smoke exposure
causes.note: Smoke inhalation, burns, and airway compromise are priority concerns in thermal incidents.

causes.label: Crush, entrapment, or structural collapse
causes.note: Compression injuries and internal trauma can be present even when the external injury is limited.

causes.label: Blunt-force impact or struck-by events
causes.note: Assess for pain, restricted movement, chest or abdomen complaints, and head injury signs.

causes.label: Sharp or penetrating object hazards
causes.note: Bleeding, penetration, and severe tissue injury can develop even when the wound seems small.

causes.label: Unknown or mixed hazard conditions
causes.note: Use responder-entered information and scene context to guide a cautious human review.

injuryPatterns.label: Head, neck, or spinal concern
injuryPatterns.note: Restrict movement when there is concern for trauma to the head, neck, or spine.

injuryPatterns.label: Chest or abdominal trauma concern
injuryPatterns.note: Breathing, pain, and swelling should prompt immediate human review and medical escalation.

injuryPatterns.label: Limb deformity, swelling, or severe pain
injuryPatterns.note: Movement restriction or swelling may indicate a serious injury requiring assessment.

injuryPatterns.label: Breathing difficulty or smoke exposure
injuryPatterns.note: Airway and breathing concerns require rapid escalation to emergency responders.

injuryPatterns.label: Bleeding or shock concern
injuryPatterns.note: Hemorrhage or suspected shock should be reviewed immediately by trained responders.

signals.label: Person reported unresponsive or not fully awake
signals.note: Responder-entered warning sign; seek emergency services and follow dispatcher guidance.

signals.label: Person reported not breathing normally or only gasping
signals.note: Responder-entered warning sign; seek emergency services and follow dispatcher guidance.

signals.label: Life-threatening bleeding reported
signals.note: Responder-entered warning sign; seek emergency services and follow dispatcher guidance.

signals.label: Possible head, neck, or spinal injury reported
signals.note: Do not use this interface to assess or move the person; follow dispatcher and trained responder instructions.

signals.label: Another immediate life-threatening condition reported
signals.note: Responder-entered warning sign; seek emergency services and follow dispatcher guidance.

signals.label: Pain or limited movement reported; severity not assessed
signals.note: Needs in-person assessment by a qualified responder; this signal does not identify an injury.

signals.label: Person status is unknown or cannot be confirmed
signals.note: Keep status unconfirmed and request an in-person welfare check by responders.
